messages:
Nia: Huge thanks to Owen and Samir for jumping on the weird memory leak during the partner demo. You two turned panic into cookies :cookie:
Owen: Glad we caught it early. Samir spotted the runaway iterator in the batcher loop — one extra while() and the heap started growing.
Samir: Yep, silly off-by-one. Patched the loop and added a small test that reproduces the leak locally.
Lila: Massive appreciate. Also thanks for explaining the fix to the partner engineer so the rest of the demo could proceed smoothly.
Nia: For the record: Samir saved the demo; Owen kept the logs readable; Lila calmed stakeholders. Team trifecta!
ops-bot: Incident #2056-88 resolved by Owen, Samir. Duration: 22m. Tags: memory, demo, partner.
Owen: I left a tiny snippet in #eng-runtime pinned items: `fix/batcher-guard` with the minimal repro. Feel free to copy into your local tests.
Samir: Adding a one-liner to the runbook now so future demos check the batcher bounds before full load tests.
Lila: Im bringing a tin of shortbread to the kitchen tomorrow as a thank-you. First-come-first-served :yum:
Nia: Shortbread party confirmed. Also Im adding a blurb to the post-demo notes: "verify batcher bounds + memory watch". Thanks again, all :sparkles:
